name: Mesh-to-Voxel Geometry Shader
definition: A real-time DirectX geometry shader technique that converts mesh objects into voxel-like cubes by iterating over integer grid positions within the triangle's bounding box and emitting cube geometry for positions close to the triangle plane.
summary: The Mesh-to-Voxel Geometry Shader is a DirectX technique that explicitly generates 3D cube geometry for intersecting voxels, differing from rasterization by emitting actual triangle strips.
